measurand_decomposition.indication: Isotope ratios d13C/d15N in consumer tissue (IRMS delta values)
measurand_decomposition.bridge_model: Bayesian mixing model with trophic discrimination factors (TDFs)

blindness_map.description: Many distinct diet mixtures yield identical isotope ratios
blindness_map.consequence: mixing models return a posterior over diets, not 'the diet' — often reported as one

blindness_map.description: Unsampled food sources are excluded from the mixing model a priori
blindness_map.consequence: the true diet component is invisible if nobody isotopically characterized it

blindness_map.description: Tissue integrates only the assimilation window — no memory beyond turnover
blindness_map.consequence: seasonal diet shifts vanish depending on tissue choice
